answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the haven queue naming the zenith that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every sock puppet costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the ledge record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
